Quantinuum has demonstrated a factor‑12 reduction in quantum error rates on its Helios platform, marking a significant step toward more reliable qubit operations. In parallel, Sandia National Laboratories announced that its Apollo system is now deemed feasible for scaling up to larger, fault‑tolerant quantum processors. Together, these developments indicate accelerated progress in both hardware performance and the roadmap for practical large‑scale quantum computing.
